'''2014 US Nationals Day 1 Josh Mack DS Wookiee Slaving Operation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Josh Mack]] at [[2014 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Wookiee Slaving Operation / Indentured To The Empire|VB8-D-wookieeslavingoperation-pre.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Renmaker
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
